1648.cn_desc: 长描述: 帽毯是冬季必不可少的东西之一，寒冷的冬天，有连帽式披肩，即使是自己也一个人能暖暖的，又柔软又舒适。 我们使用 超细纤维材质—— 吸水、速干、轻盈、不粘沙 。 内里又是包边设计，车线均匀工整，凸显严谨工艺； 不管是自己用还是送人都很合适 短描述： （1）超柔印花布加奶白色北极绒的面料，温暖舒适 （2）支持两种宽度高度的款式定制

1654.en_desc: 10.21 Acceptance Record Summary: 1. [New Field] Add an English description field and a rich text box. --p1 2. [Optimization of Data Display and Initialization] Export the enumeration values for three data items [Color], [Size], and [Attribute] to the group for confirmation by the demand party. Initialize according to the data organized by the demand party. For subsequent additions and changes, the demand party will configure through the backend. --p2 3. [New] Backend, add configuration interfaces for [Color], [Size], and [Attribute], with a new field [Display Channel:] dropdown list, including options such as Backend, Merchant Side, Factory Side, SaaS, default value = Backend. Historical data defaults to Backend. --p1 4. [UI Optimization] Swap the positions of two buttons on the merchant side --p3 5. The following modules require gray guiding text, which will be displayed when empty. --p1 1. Please provide key physical parameters of the product, ensuring that units are filled in (e.g., cm, m, inch, etc.) Example: A product size is 90.0 inches/230 cm long and 70.8 inches/180 cm wide 2. Please provide accurate product weight and packaging specifications information 3. Please describe the basic product information of the product, including but not limited to: [Design Description] Single-sided design/double-sided design/full-width design; [Material Description] List all materials and processes used for the main body and accessories in detail; [Product Performance] Describe the core functions, usage effects, and advantages of the product; [Applicable Scenarios] Explain suitable use occasions, target groups, and specific problems it can solve; [Accessories Description] List all product accessories and quantities inside the packaging; 4. Please supplement the English description part of the basic product information based on the above product details 6. New - [Optimization of Interaction] Material and Shipping Region, support fuzzy search input, optimized together by the merchant side and management backend. --p2 7. [New] Backend, Select Product Application Review - Menu, add a red dot to display the total number of pending reviews + products to be created.

Historical data defaults to Backend. --p1 4. [UI Optimization] Swap the positions of two buttons on the merchant side --p3 5. The following modules require gray guiding text, which will be displayed when empty. --p1 1. Please provide key physical parameters of the product, ensuring that units are filled in (e.g., cm, m, inch, etc.) Example: A product size is 90.0 inches/230 cm long and 70.8 inches/180 cm wide 2. Please describe the basic product information of the product, including but not limited to: [Design Description] Single-sided design/double-sided design/full-width design; [Material Description] List all materials and processes used for the main body and accessories in detail; [Product Performance] Describe the core functions, usage effects, and advantages of the product; [Applicable Scenarios] Explain suitable use occasions, target groups, and specific problems it can solve; [Accessories Description] List all product accessories and quantities inside the packaging; 4. Please supplement the English description part of the basic product information based on the above product details 6. New - [Optimization of Interaction] Material and Shipping Region, support fuzzy search input, optimized together by the merchant side and management backend. --p2 7. [New] Backend, Select Product Application Review - Menu, add a red dot to display the total number of pending reviews + products to be created.

[Optimization of Data Display and Initialization] Export the enumeration values for three data items [Color], [Size], and [Attribute] to the group for confirmation by the demand party. Please provide key physical parameters of the product, ensuring that units are filled in (e.g., cm, m, inch, etc.) Example: A product size is 90.0 inches/230 cm long and 70.8 inches/180 cm wide 2. Please describe the basic product information of the product, including but not limited to: [Design Description] Single-sided design/double-sided design/full-width design; [Material Description] List all materials and processes used for the main body and accessories in detail; [Product Performance] Describe the core functions, usage effects, and advantages of the product; [Applicable Scenarios] Explain suitable use occasions, target groups, and specific problems it can solve; [Accessories Description] List all product accessories and quantities inside the packaging; 4.
